subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the cost price and selling price of four articles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87ff64b9b90ae2411a115cd3a70e742303e23ec0f61254eac6ab74ee99d44e75.png] 

What is the ratio of average selling price of M and N to the average cost price of P and Q?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The average selling price of M and N = (400 + 650)/2 = 525

The average cost price of P and Q = (600 + 900)/2 = 750

The ratio is:

525 : 750

7 : 10

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
